text:
mika: Sprocket conquered his first sweater today. tiny hedgehog, huge attitude. photo dump incoming 🦔🧥
ben: that face 😭 so regal.
alyssa: omg the sleeves! is that a custom knit or Etsy magic? :sweater:
sam: Teach me your ways, I can barely get my cat to tolerate a band-aid.
mika: It was @katie's work — she knit a teeny tube and we slid him in during snack time. He only grunted once.
ben: video? I need to see the roll-and-freeze pose.
mika: posted clip — Sprocket does a slow pivot, then flops. Sound: tiny snort.
ops-bot: Reminder: pet-photos channel tomorrow 2pm if anyone wants to swap tips for tiny-clothing. :calendar:
alyssa: 100% attending. Sprocket's sweater pattern please!
sam: Vote: sweater or tiny backpack? Type "sweater" or "backpack"
mika: sweater
ben: backpack
alyssa: sweater
sam: backpack
mika: tie-breaker: sweater gets three votes. backpack gets two. democracy stands.
ben: also whoever mentions a tiny helmet is banned. :no_entry_sign:
